title: Characters
guidance: Fields: name, look, wardrobe, voice, mannerisms. Pass an example id, one JSON object, or a JSON list of up to three objects in the node's character input.
Reuse the same look and wardrobe text in every shot to keep a character consistent.
Dialogue goes in the idea, in quotes, with the speaker named.

entries.name: Mara Voss
entries.label: Mara Voss - restless detective
entries.look: a woman in her late thirties with cropped silver-streaked dark hair, sharp cheekbones and tired grey eyes
entries.wardrobe: a charcoal wool coat over a faded black shirt
entries.voice: low, dry and measured, with a slight rasp
entries.mannerisms: taps two fingers on whatever is nearby when she thinks and rarely smiles

entries.name: Tomas Reyes
entries.label: Tomas Reyes - friendly chef
entries.look: a broad-shouldered man in his fifties with a warm weathered face, a greying beard and flour on his forearms
entries.wardrobe: a white apron over rolled-up sleeves
entries.mannerisms: hums quietly while he works and wipes his hands on his apron before he speaks

entries.name: Kai Nakamura
entries.label: Kai Nakamura - young skater
entries.look: a lean young man in his early twenties with messy black hair, a lopsided grin and a small scar on his chin
entries.wardrobe: an oversized orange hoodie, loose jeans and worn white sneakers
entries.mannerisms: bounces on his toes, flicks his hair back and laughs at his own jokes
